verdict.rationale: Whether an inference service publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. The evidence shows a public TypeScript client SDK repo but never states its license, and it says nothing about Groq's own service source being open. The open-weight GPT-OSS model is a third-party model Groq hosts, not Groq's product source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
